## Overview

Draft, written with Claude Code; stays draft until the submitter reviews every line. MoRIIO hybrid (KDA/Mamba) READ re-reads attention pages the decoder already caches; this reads only external-token pages.

Not duplicates: #48471 (non-hybrid length mismatch), #62165 (SWA tail clipping). Rebased on #60867.

## Claims

- With a decoder prefix-cache hit, hybrid READ moves only the full-attention pages for tokens `[N-1-E, N-1)` (`N` prompt length, `E` final `num_external_tokens`). KDA/Mamba and state attention groups are unchanged.
- Full-attention tables that do not cover that range raise `MoRIIOError` instead of being tail-aligned.
- No throughput claim: the tested workload is prefill-queue bound.

## Validation

- `test_moriio_hma_scheduler.py`: main @ 5689c27 110 passed, PR 119 passed, new tests on main connector 13 failed. All MoRIIO unit tests: 438 passed, 33 skipped. ruff 0.14.0 clean.
- Kimi-K3 1P1D TP8/DCP8, 2 x 8 MI355X: on all 8 decode ranks, 32 sampled prefix-hit transfers READ exactly the missing pages; attention READ 45.77 GB to 12.11 GB (pre-rebase code, same for one MLA group).
- 3600 s agentic replay, concurrency 48: 4273 succeeded, 9 empty-content errors (unpatched: 9).
- No accuracy eval: skipped pages are the decoder's own cached pages.

<details><summary>Commands, revert-red and GPU setup</summary>

```bash
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu PYTHONPATH=$PWD \
  python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_moriio_hma_scheduler.py
uvx ruff@0.14.0 check <changed files>
uvx ruff@0.14.0 format --check <changed files>
```

Revert-red, new tests with the main connector: 6 x `test_scheduler_accepts_dspark_with_wrapped_full_attention` and `test_scheduler_accepts_glm5_next_groups_with_mtp` (main has no `_attn_read_block_sizes`), `test_glm5_next_mtp_read_pairs_every_group[476-1]`, 2 x `test_update_state_rejects_incomplete_attention_tables`, `test_update_state_selects_missing_attention_pages[128]` and `[192]`, `test_update_state_uses_final_external_token_count[128]`.

GPU build: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-81198e97` plus this fix before the #60867 rebase, which only made the selection per attention group. MoRIIO READ, prefix caching on both sides, prefill-side MultiConnector (MoRIIO + SimpleCPUOffloadConnector), DSpark speculative decoding, FP8 KV. One attention page is 12288 tokens after DCP sharding. The decoder's local prefix hit was 89.7% of prompt tokens.

Sampled transfers came after warmup, with `E > 0` and at least one complete cached decoder page. A per-rank observer recorded READ submissions and completions; bytes are logical payload.

| | attention pages | attention GB | KDA GB | total GB |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| old selection, same transfers (offline) | 223 | 45.77 | 15.03 | 60.80 |
| this PR (observed) | 59 | 12.11 | 15.03 | 27.14 |

Throughput 10557 tok/s/chip vs 10882 for the unpatched run, which used a different cluster, so not a controlled A/B. Decoder `request_prefill_time` avg 0.12 s unpatched vs 0.11 s patched; prefill-side queue avg 13.8 s vs 16.2 s.
</details>

## Details

Root cause on the decoder:

1. The local prefix hit covers `[0, L)`, so `E = N - 1 - L`.
2. `update_state_after_alloc` gets complete attention tables, cached pages included.
3. `_align_read_blocks` paired P and D tables by length and tail, so READ also covered `[0, L)`.
4. Fix: per full-attention group, slice both by page `[(N-1-E) // B, ceil((N-1) / B))`, `B` = its block size x DCP when sharded; window-clipped and state groups keep `_align_read_blocks`.

```diff
 for local, remote, read_block_size in zip(..., self._attn_read_block_sizes):
-    self._align_read_blocks(local, remote, self._max_decode_tail_blocks)
+    if read_block_size is None:  # window-clipped or state group
+        self._align_read_blocks(local, remote, self._max_decode_tail_blocks)
+    else:
+        self._select_read_attention(request, E, local, remote, read_block_size)
```

- Contract change: a shorter decoder table (the removed test's receive suffix) now raises; a real `KVCacheManager` case and the GPU run pass complete tables.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
